Subject: Renewal kickoff + capacity uplift — Brightspan (BRIGHT-4571)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive renewal signals last week. I wanted to kick off a short, focused thread to align timelines, stakeholders, and next steps for the upcoming renewal and the proposed capacity uplift (estimated +35% token throughput). Goal is to get a mutual action plan in place this month so we can lock pricing and staffing ahead of your Q4 ramp.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Confirm the internal stakeholders on your side (procurement, engineering lead for inference, security if required).
- Confirm whether you want a 12- or 24-month term for the uplift (we can show economics both ways).
- Share any legal timing constraints (contract review windows, procurement blackout dates).

Proposed timeline (suggested):
1) This week: stakeholder list + availability for a 30-minute kick call.
2) Week of 8/24: Draft SOW + pricing options shared.
3) Week of 8/31: Legal & procurement review; DocuSign path if agreed.
4) Early Sept: QBR + handoff to CS for onboarding schedule.

I’ve attached last quarter’s usage export (usage_report_q1.csv) so we can baseline throughput needs. Ben — can you prepare two term/pricing scenarios (12m/24m) that show unit economics with and without burst capacity? Soojin / Marissa — please stay looped for QBR slot options and onboarding staffing.

Next step: Sarah/Tom — can you share 3 times you’re available for a 30-minute kickoff this week? I’ll run a quick calendar poll and include the team.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
